name: Hyena
description: A hyena is a carnivorous animal known for its strong jaws, distinctive laughing vocalizations, and scavenging habits. They often hunt in packs and are adept at both hunting and scavenging in their environment.

actions.name: Savage Bite
actions.description: The hyena uses its strong jaws to deliver a powerful bite that deals physical damage. On a true hit, the creature must roll a resilience check greater than or higher to the total damage dealt after mitigation or gain the wounded condition.

actions.name: Relentless Hunter
actions.description: When a creature moves away from the hyena, it can move up to 4 units towards it.

actions.name: Nipping Bite
actions.description: The hyena makes a quick attack at a creature's lower leg, dealing physical damage. If the attack deals damage after mitigation, the affected creature has -2 walk speed until the end of its next turn. This affect can be applied more than once by other hyenas.

traits.name: Sense Weakness
traits.description: The hyena gains a 1d4 attack bonus against creatures who are in lifeline or have the wounded condition.
